## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem or motivation, what changes, and any related issue.
For a bug fix, include a small reproduction or before/after example.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their results. Mark checks not run and explain why.
For documentation, verify referenced paths, commands, and claims. GPU training and
paid inference are not required.

## Evidence and limits

Explain remaining unverified behavior or compatibility limits. If results change,
identify the dataset/split, model revision, prompt/decoding settings, metric units,
and whether the data influenced checkpoint selection. Link existing reports
instead of uploading weights, generated data, raw outputs, or sensitive logs.
